artworks.title: Pope Gregory the Great and Saint Vitale Interceding for the Souls in Purgatory
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting heavenly and earthly figures interacting in a dream-like scene. A group of angelic figures with wings emerge from swirling clouds, interacting with figures below. The bottom section shows a bearded man and another seated figure pointing towards the sky. Angelic beings guide or lift souls upwards, continuing the celestial theme. The background includes clouds, a desolate landscape with a tower, and sparse trees. The artwork uses swirling lines for the clouds and detailed textures for the figures' clothing and features, conveying movement in the composition.

artworks.title: Nine Figures around a Herm of Pan
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with mythological elements. It features several figures situated in a natural outdoor setting. The figures are arranged in a harmonious composition, engaged in various activities. The landscape behind them includes trees, plants, and clouds, suggesting a serene countryside. The style of the drawing embodies elegance and balance, with meticulous attention to detail in the human forms and natural surroundings.

artworks.title: Six Nymphs and Two Cupids in a Landscape
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures with a towering structure and a tree in the background. The scene depicts several human forms, some reclining, in a pastoral setting that includes a large cylindrical tower on the left and a tall tree to the right. A winged cherub-like figure interacts with the group. The setting blends natural and architectural elements. The shading and line work are detailed, employing cross-hatching techniques. The background includes an expansive landscape view.

artworks.title: Venus and Vulcan with Three Nymphs and Three Cupids
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an outdoor setting. The image depicts multiple figures arranged in a classical, allegorical scene. In the foreground, there are figures in various poses. One seated figure has prominent musculature, while another stands with grace or authority. Around them are other figures. The background features a large urn on a plinth and sparse foliage, creating a classical landscape. The sky is illustrated with swirling lines representing clouds, contributing to the dynamic composition of the scene.

artworks.title: A Satyr with a Staff and Seven Other Figures
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological or allegorical scene with architectural elements and draped figures. The drawing portrays a group of figures situated around a large urn that rests upon a stone plinth. On the left side, an elderly figure appears to be conversing with another adult figure who is sitting and holding an infant or small child on their lap. Meanwhile, the reclining figure on the ground, semi-draped, seems to be interacting with the other figures. Behind them, two figures stand, their gestures suggesting conversation. The background depicts an expansive sky with expressive cloud forms. Elements of nature, such as a tree, and slight hints of a distant landscape enhance the setting’s serene yet classical ambiance.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Iphigenia
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting various figures in a dynamic scene with a supernatural element. The image features a central figure being carried away by another figure emerging from a cloud-like mass. Surrounding them are other figures in different states of frantic activity, with one figure on the ground shielding their face. The background shows a grand architectural structure with arches, contributing to the grandiose setting. The scene conveys chaos, urgency, and supernatural intervention through the interaction between the main figures and the cloud.

artworks.title: Sofonisba (or Artemisia)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene with people, animals, and architecture. The scene includes individuals in period clothing, an ornate structure with columns, and a small dog and another animal in the foreground. A central figure is seated, surrounded by other figures. In the background, there is a building with statues on the rooftop and a figure holding a long spear-like object. The drawing uses delicate lines and shading for depth and detail.

artworks.title: Alexander the Great and Campaspe in the Studio of Apelles
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist painting a portrait that features classical figures in an architectural setting. The scene shows a group of figures surrounding an artist working at an easel. The artist is capturing the likeness of a seated figure dressed elegantly, accompanied by another figure in military-style garb. The setting includes architectural elements like columns and urns, with a backdrop of an expansive vista beyond an arcade. Each character is detailed with historical clothing, and there are props like shields and a hound at the artist's feet.

artworks.title: A Bacchanal
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of black chalk on laid paper, mounted on an old album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with mythological elements. The foreground features several figures reclining beneath the shade of large, flowing trees. At the center, two figures seem to be engaged in a serene interaction, perhaps sharing a drink from a large vessel. To the left, another figure lounges, holding a small cluster of grapes. The background shows distant, rugged mountains under a sky partially filled with clouds and sweeping lines. The use of ink and wash contributes to a classic, ancient feel, while the detailed rendering of the figures and foliage enhances the narrative quality of the drawing.

artworks.title: A Hillside Path with Blooming Cherry Trees under an Overcast Sky
artworks.medium: pastel, charcoal, and stumping with touches of gouache on blue paper laid down on card
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with a path, trees, foliage, a tree with pink blossoms, and a sky with warm yellow light. The painting has a variety of colors, textures, and brushstrokes that create a dynamic and impressionistic scene.

artworks.title: The Aqua Claudia in the Roman Campagna
artworks.medium: pastel on paper laid down on board
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins on the left side of a landscape painting. The ruins are weathered and reddish-brown, contrasting with the surrounding greenery. A horizon is visible in the middle of the painting, with more ruins extending into the distance. Distant mountains are softly rendered in blue and gray tones. The sky fills the upper half of the painting with gentle, flowing clouds against a pale blue backdrop. A flock of birds flies across the sky above the ruins. The color palette includes warm reds, browns, greens, and blue-gray tones, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Victoria Publica
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: Four people are depicted in this image. The central figure is standing, examining a long cylindrical object. They wear a large hat, fur-lined jacket, and a scarf. To the left, another person holds a torch. To the right, a person holds a stick-like object. Behind them, a person is barely visible, smiling. The background is dark, emphasizing the torch's light casting shadows and highlights.

artworks.title: Two Intertwined Oak Trees
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up perspective of a tree, highlighting the intricate textured surface of the trunk and lower branches. The horizon is not clearly defined, allowing focus on the foreground. The brushstrokes are detailed, with a black and gray palette against a beige background, creating texture and a dappled leaf effect. Earthy tones dominate the color palette. The environment beyond the tree is softly sketched, hinting at additional foliage. The artist conveys the tree's complexity through varied line work and shading.

artworks.title: Prochainement la très illustre Compagnie du Chat Noir (Poster for the Company of the Black Cat)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper, mounted on muslin
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: A black cat sitting on a red block looks out at us in this vertical poster. The background is parchment brown, and the poster is printed with ruby red and inky black. The cat sits to the left of center with its body facing our right almost in profile. Its tall, narrow shoulders are drawn together, creating a ruff like a mink stole around its face, and its fur stands up in curling bristles along its back. Its head turns to us with the ears flattened out to the sides over eyes defined with only tall, narrow slits for pupils. Long whiskers flounce up and out from its lowered eyebrows and prim muzzle. A halo-like, red shape around its head has geometric patterns around a band of curving, organically shaped text, “MONTJOYE MONTMARTRE.” Its claws make a row of black points along the top edge of the red block on which it sits, and its tail curls down over the words there. Red and black text across the entire poster and into the block read, “PROCHAINEMENT la très illustre Compagnie du CHAT NOIR avec ses PIÈCES d’OMBRES CÈLÈBRES, ses POËTES ses COMPOSITEURS AVCE RODOLPHE SALIS.” Text running vertically up the right edge in that corner reads, “Imp. CHARLES VERNEAU, 114, Rue Oberkampf, PARIS.”

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child with Two Angels and Saints Scholastica, Benedict, Roch, Peter, Paul and Jerome
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene with several figures surrounding a monumental column under clouds. The figures are in various postures and gestures, and some are seated or kneeling while others are standing. In the upper right corner, there are cloud formations with figures on them. The central focus is on converging figures with dramatic gestures, emphasized by the lighting and contrasts of the etching technique. The column adds grandeur and timelessness, while the details suggest a historic or religious significance.

artworks.title: Scholars Consulting Books and a Globe
artworks.medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor and gouache, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image displays swirling curves and overlapping lines creating an abstract composition. A flowing form occupies the central space, with a lion-like figure at the top, and a spherical object below. An open book and geometric shapes are also included. The background features radiating lines.

artworks.title: Portasi in Valle il Cavalier... (Arrival of the Master)
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Pietro Longhi
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and Florian Carr Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple individuals in 18th-century attire surrounding a central figure. The central figure is wearing a tricorn hat, a long coat, knee-length pants, stockings, and buckled shoes. The other figures are dressed in simpler attire, with differing poses, facial features, and hairstyles. A small dog stands in the foreground, and the background shows an indistinct interior space with a high ceiling.

artworks.title: Ne-Sou-A Quoit, a Fox Chief
artworks.artist: Albert Newsam, after Charles Bird King
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Donald and Nancy de Laski Fund

artworks.title: An Elegant Parisiènne Seated in a Café
artworks.medium: black chalk, watercolor, and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated at a small wooden table in a side profile, with her hands clasped and resting on the table. She has fair skin, an updo hairstyle, and wears a dress with long sleeves, decorative buttons, bows, and a cinched waist. The dress has dark and light tones, with a full skirt. She also wears a wide-brimmed hat with a large red decoration. The background is reddish with a green band at the bottom, and a shadow of the woman is visible.

artworks.title: Woman Riding a Man
artworks.medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and shapes forming an abstract composition. In the center, a figure with exaggerated proportions is depicted. The surrounding colors are muted green and brown tones. Abstract curves and lines resemble trees or foliage and intermingle with dynamic motion. A circular motif at the bottom contains a bird-like shape. The overall scene is a lively blend of shapes hinting at a whimsical, storybook quality.

artworks.title: Woman Consulting a Book
artworks.medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor and gouache, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image consists of intricate lines and circular shapes, forming an abstract composition. At the center is a wheel or clock-like structure divided into segments with symbols resembling astrological signs. Above the circular motif is a collection of colorful, flowing forms suggesting a reclining figure in elaborate, ruffled garments. The combination of abstract elements with a figurative representation merges familiar objects, encouraging viewers to explore the interplay of shapes and colors.

artworks.title: Man Driving an Animal
artworks.medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: Swirling, curved lines and shapes create an abstract scene. The arrangement of these shapes resembles an antelope or deer-like animal within a vortex-like setting. Vibrant red and earthy tones alongside greens and browns mimic colors found in nature, with plant forms in the center suggesting vegetation.

artworks.title: Putti Leading a Goat
artworks.medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image displays swirling, curvilinear shapes and lines creating an abstract composition with organic and circular motifs. The top section shows shapes resembling animals with elongated bodies and legs, possibly deer, amidst lush foliage. Below, a circular pattern filled with floral elements surrounds a textured oval shape, which could resemble a stylized pond or celestial body, like a moon in a garden. The elements combine to form a dynamic and cohesive artwork with a blend of natural scenery and artistic elements.

artworks.title: Rabbit and Two Fighting Men
artworks.medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor and gouache, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image contains curved lines and shapes swirling around a central point. It has an abstract nature with vibrant colors merging into each other. In the center at the bottom, there is an animal figure resembling a rabbit nestled within a tunnel or archway formed by the shapes. The swirling colors and shapes suggest movement and depth.
